headline: Six Sectors Surge as Frontlines Shift
war_summary: Three hours after the last dispatch the map shows a reshuffling of the most volatile sectors. Stlican Shelf remains the busiest theatre, logging four ownership changes in the past two hours and forty‑six in the day, though the two‑hour tempo has eased from the prior ten flips. Weathered Expanse has awakened, recording five flips in the latest two‑hour window and twenty‑two overall, a sharp rise from its earlier lull. Deadlands, previously quiet, now reports two recent flips and eleven daily, while Godcrofts has entered the fray with two fresh changes and eleven in the last twenty‑four hours. Callahans Passage, which flared briefly, has slipped to zero flips in the newest two‑hour slice but still holds three in six hours. Linn Mercy, though devoid of base turnovers, exhibits accelerating casualty streams — 182 colonial and 199 warden losses per hour — and a climbing enlistment rate of fifty‑four per hour. Casualty rates are climbing on Stlican, Callahans, Weathered, Linn Mercy and Terminus, while enlistments surge at Callahans and Kings Cage but dip on Weathered and Stlican. The deep Warden interior and the Colonial‑held southern fringe remain static with no base turnovers.
